Gravity Falls - Legend of the Gnome Gemu.name: Gravity Falls: Legend of the Gnome Gemulets
Gravity Falls - Legend of the Gnome Gemu.summary: Gravity Falls: Legend of the Gnome Gemulets is a side-scrolling platform game. Players assume control of Dipper and Mabel, and they can freely switch between them at any moment during the game. The two characters have different abilities. Dipper can combat enemies with a close-ranged weapon called Gnome Battle Cuffs and look for clues using a flashlight, while Mabel can utilize a grappling hook to reach high grounds, and combat enemies with ranged attacks by her "Fleece of Bedazzlement-enhanced sweater sleeves".

Magi - Hajimari no Meikyuu.name: Magi: Hajimari no Meikyuu
Magi - Hajimari no Meikyuu.summary: To raise enough capital to purchase a country and to find the Metal of Jin, Alibaba and the genie summoner Aladdin set off to conquer the challenges in the 7th labyrinth Amon. The game is spilt into the adventure part and the battle part. Meet the captivating characters and watch the memorable dialogues in the iconic scenes in the adventure part. And when you have enough information, meet the bosses you have read about in the manga. The parallel mode in the game allows you to create your own team. Use different characters to fight the enemies in the dungeon and unlock special story events.

Mario & Luigi - Superstar Saga + Bowser'.name: Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga + Bowser's Minions
Mario & Luigi - Superstar Saga + Bowser'.summary:
"The game that launched the Mario & Luigi series returns looking better than ever before.

In this renewed classic, Mario and Luigi journey to the Beanbean Kingdom with Bowser to restore Princess Peach’s voice. Control Mario and Luigi simultaneously, making use of their unique Bros. Moves to solve puzzles and emerge victorious in action-packed battles. Pay heed to the enemy’s patterns and time your reactions right to land satisfying counterblows.

Included in this remake is the Minion Quest: The Search for Bowser mode, which tells the story of the game from the perspective of Bowser’s minions. Recruit characters to grow your own Minion army as you fight to locate your missing leader!"

Medarot 8 - Kabuto Ver..name: Medarot 8: Kabuto Version
Medarot 8 - Kabuto Ver..summary:
Medarot 8 is the eighth main installment in the Medarot series.

The game features a new cast of characters and over 200 Medarots to collect. Like previous games, it was released in Kabuto and Kuwagata versions where the player starts with Metabee or Rokusho, respectively.

The story follows a new protagonist named Salt and his adventures as part of the Laurel Detective Bureau, which investigates Medarot-related crimes.

Metroid Prime - Federation Force.name: Metroid Prime: Federation Force
Metroid Prime - Federation Force.summary:
"The galaxy is not at peace. The war between the Galactic Federation and the Space Pirates is far from over. Enlist with the Federation Force to join a four-player local or online squad in this co-op sci-fi shooter. Fight alongside teammates in your specialized Mech to eliminate the Space Pirate menace and any threat that stands in your way.

Make it a solitary mission or join 3 friends for increased firepower and deeper strategies. In each mission, you'll choose your role on the team by selecting from different subweapons and MODs to customize your Mech and maximize your chance of survival. Whether you focus on healing allies or increasing your arsenal, your greatest asset is teamwork. Work together, tackle missions, take down bosses, and defeat hostile creatures as one powerful unit. The dangerous Metroid Prime universe is now at your mercy. Honor your vow to protect it and fight back...before there’s nothing left to fight for. The next chapter in the Metroid Prime saga is here."

Tanoshiku - Omoshiroku - Kanken Shougaku.name: Tanoshiku Omoshiroku Kanken Shougakusei
Tanoshiku - Omoshiroku - Kanken Shougaku.summary:
A meaningful kanji learning software that can be used not only at home, but also at school.
The revision of the 2020 learning guidance increases the learning kanji from 1006 to 1026 (first for 30 years! ) , It is gaining attention on learning Chinese characters.
Certified by the Japanese Kanji Ability Certification Association, and responds to the latest past questions from Chinese Checkout Class 10 (about low - ending) to Class 2 (high school, university, and general usage). Incorporating the know-how of the previous Doraemon series has been infused with Chinese Character mini games.
